Overview
Many creators and workers in the adult industry have shifted to online platforms (e.g., subscription sites, video-on-demand, pay-per-view, and social media). This migration has changed income models, working conditions, and power dynamics between performers, producers, and platforms.

Key points to consider

- Safety and privacy: Online distribution can give performers more control over what they publish, but it also raises risks of doxxing, image-based abuse, and nonconsensual redistribution.
